title: 5 prompts for your job search

sources.name: Prompting guidance: supply real context and ask for a defined output

caption:
5 prompts to make job applications faster: sharper resume bullets, a cover letter draft, interview practice, a follow-up and a skills check.
Use only true details about your own experience and review everything before you send it.
Save this job search set. Comment JOBS and I will send the prompt list.

slides.headline: Only use true details
body: Never invent experience, skills or results.
Use AI to say real things more clearly.

slides.headline: Sharpen resume bullets
body: Paste your real bullet and the job posting.
slides.prompt: Rewrite this bullet to be clearer and more specific, using only facts I gave: [bullet]. Match the language in this job posting where it is true: [posting].

slides.headline: Draft a cover letter
body: A starting point, never a finished letter.
slides.prompt: Draft a short cover letter for [role] at [company]. Use only these facts about me: [facts]. Keep it under 200 words and avoid cliches.

slides.headline: Practice the interview
body: Answer out loud, then ask for feedback.
slides.prompt: Ask me one interview question at a time for [role]. After each answer, give feedback on clarity and suggest one improvement.

slides.headline: Write the follow-up
body: Short, polite and easy to answer.
slides.prompt: Write a brief thank-you email after an interview for [role]. Mention [specific topic we discussed] and restate my interest in two sentences.

slides.headline: Spot your skills gap
body: Compare what they want with what you have.
slides.prompt: Compare this job posting [posting] with my experience [summary]. List matches, gaps and learning I could do to close them.

slides.headline: Make it sound like you
body: Read it aloud and change anything stiff.

slides.headline: Check every detail
body: Names, dates and job titles must be correct.
Remove anything that is not true.

slides.headline: Save this job search set
body: Comment JOBS and I will send the prompt list.
Share this with someone applying this month.
